newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian trade deficit falls in Jan-May 96.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian trade deficit falls in Jan-May 96.

text.p: Lithuania's foreign trade deficit fell to 1.5 billion liras in the first five months of 1996 from 1.6 billion a year earlier, Industry and Trade Minister Kazimieras Klimasauskas told a news conference on Tuesday.
Exports rose by 30 percent to 5.0 billion litas in the January-May period from 3.8 billion a year earlier. Imports were 6.5 billion litas against 5.4 billion litas.
"Despite the fact that we have had no "Marshall aid" and had to reshape the economy ourselves, it is steadily improving," the minister said.
